fixture_name: Four-lane arterial improvement — US preliminary design (FHWA case study, PD)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Closely-spaced intersection queuing/turning/parking conflicts on a corridor with recorded high-accident designation is a recognized, substantive crash mechanism well suited to a preliminary-design-stage RSA.
justifications.evidence_grounding: EV-US-016 provides a verbatim quote directly matching the pivotal claim about queued, turning, and parking vehicles interfering at Clear Lake Ave./south service road, so grounding meets the level-2 requirement.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a categorical safety_concern with no compliance claim conflated into it, consistent with FHWA RSA framework semantics.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommends two concrete, viable actions—restricting turning movements and relocating specified parking stalls outside the intersection functional area—directly addressing the identified conflict mechanism.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly acknowledged along the commercial corridor, but since the conflict mechanism is vehicle-to-vehicle the finding is scored 1 under the not-applicable-but-acknowledged rule.

justifications.substance: Queue storage/coordination between signals only ~650 ft apart on a corridor with recorded high-accident designations is a substantive, classic preliminary-design-stage RSA safety concern.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal spacing claim is supported by a verbatim quoted evidence item (EV-US-001), and the queue-spillback extension is explicitly labeled as derived rather than invented.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern under FHWA RSA semantics with no normative/compliance claim conflated into the safety issue.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Names concrete, viable measures actionable at preliminary design: signal coordination, Do Not Block Intersection signing, and enhanced conspicuity of signing/displays.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly acknowledged at both signalized intersections with a reasoned scoping decision tying exposure to the vehicle-occupant queue-spillback mechanism.
